text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I done messed up. An' here I 
thought I was bein' careful not to get 
injured...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I've still got a long way to 
go, huh. ...I'm sorry for causing trouble 
for you too, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
No need to apologize. More importantly, 
for today—

You don't need to apologize. More 
importantly, for today—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, Trainer-san. Please don't say any 
more."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I will continue my training. ...I beg of 
you, please let me continue.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...All the girls around me are nothing 
but strong."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Not only are they strong, but none of 
them ever slack off. Even right now, at 
this very moment... I bet."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"When I think about it like that, I can't 
possibly bring myself to rest."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If I take a rest here and let them pull 
ahead, I might never catch up again."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming the "star attraction" 
is on the line! Please! Let me keep 
training!
choice_data_list:
Precisely because you have a dream, you 
must endure for now.

Precisely because you have a dream, you 
should endure for now, okay?
Shall we try doing as much as we can?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming the "star attraction" 
is on the line! Please! Let me keep 
training!
choice_data_list:
Precisely because you have a dream, you 
must endure for now.

Precisely because you have a dream, you 
should endure for now, okay?
Shall we try doing as much as we can?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: T-That is...
choice_data_list:
If you push yourself too hard, you may 
find your path closed off.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...'Scuse me. Even though deep down, I 
really do understand...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't help feeling anxious. Can I 
really catch up to everyone who's already 
gone on ahead...?
choice_data_list: Figuring that out is my job.
Figuring that out is my job.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I can take your word for it, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll make sure to get all healed up 
too. After all, that's my job, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngggh?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Guess it was no good after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being so demanding... I 
really should just take a proper rest for 
now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Misjudging her own condition, Lucky Lilac 
ended up worsening her injury.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we got this, we can totally do it! 
Somehow, I'm feelin' pretty good too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
An injury is nothing short of the worst 
thing that could happen, but it looks like 
it's turning into just the right kind of 
adversity.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If I get past this, I'll definitely be 
much closer to the spotlight. Just watch 
me, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having faced adversity and persevered 
through it all, Lucky Lilac made a 
brilliant comeback.
